Marketing Lead Pharmacy Business
  
  
**Marketing Lead Pharmacy Business**
**Brussels | Full-time**
**Build brands. Create pharmacy solutions. Make an impact on patients.**
Are you passionate about healthcare marketing and eager to shape innovative solutions for pharmacists and patients?
  
  
At Servier BeLux, we are looking for a
**Marketing Lead Pharmacy Business**
to join our Cardiovascular & Venous Diseases team. This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic brand management with the development of innovative pharmacy services that create value for pharmacists, patients and healthcare professionals.
  
  
In this role, you will be at the crossroads of consumer healthcare, pharmacy engagement and prescription medicines, with a strong focus on delivering impactful solutions within the pharmacy channel and combining commercial creativity with the rigor required in a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.
  
  
**Your mission**
As Marketing Lead Pharmacy Business, you will be responsible for two complementary areas:
  
  
**Lead the pharmacy and consumer marketing strategy of a flagship consumer healthcare brand (75%)**
You will take ownership of the pharmacy and consumer activation strategy for one of our leading brands within the cardiovascular and venous disease portfolio.
  
  
Working closely with a colleague responsible for physician-focused activities, you will drive growth through:
  
  

* Development and execution of the pharmacy channel strategy while ensuring full compliance with pharmaceutical regulations, company policies and ethical standards.
* Creation of compelling sell-out programs and in-pharmacy activation campaigns
* Development of omnichannel direct-to-consumer campaigns
* Design and implementation of promotional tools and materials for the field force
* Collaboration with sales teams to maximize execution excellence in pharmacies
* Identification of new growth opportunities through customer and market insights
* Management of agencies, budgets and project timelines
* Continuous monitoring and optimisation of campaign performance

**Develop innovative pharmacy solutions for our prescription medicines portfolio (25%)**
In addition to brand responsibilities, you will play a key role in strengthening Servier's value proposition towards pharmacists.
  
  
While Product Managers focus on positioning our prescription medicines with physicians, you will identify opportunities to support pharmacists in their daily practice and improve patient care.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Identifying unmet needs and challenges encountered by pharmacists
* Translating pharmacy insights into innovative and scalable solutions
* Coordinating cross-functional projects across multiple therapeutic areas
* Developing services, tools and programs that create meaningful value for pharmacies
* Collaborating closely with Medical Affairs, Sales, Market Access, Regulatory and Digital teams
* Ensuring excellence in the execution of pharmacy-focused initiatives

**Who are you?**
You are a marketer with a strong commercial mindset who enjoys building partnerships, leading projects and creating innovative customer solutions.
  
  
You bring:
  
  

* A Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related field
* Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, OTC, consumer healthcare or pharmacy marketing
* Proven experience in brand management and customer activation
* Strong understanding of the pharmacy environment
* Experience in developing omnichannel campaigns
* Project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities
* Strong communication and influencing skills
* An entrepreneurial, proactive and hands-on mindset
* Fluency in Dutch and/or French is essential for this role. Additionally, an advanced level of English is a highly valued asset.

**Why join Servier BeLux?**
At Servier BeLux, you will join a dynamic, human-sized organisation where collaboration, trust and personal development are at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
We offer you the opportunity to :
  
  

* Lead strategic marketing initiatives with tangible business impact
* Work on both consumer healthcare and prescription medicine projects
* Shape innovative pharmacy services and solutions
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple functions
* Accelerate your career within an international pharmaceutical company committed to improving patients' lives

**Ready to shape the future of pharmacy engagement?**
Join us and help create innovative solutions that strengthen the role of pharmacists while improving outcomes for patients.
  
  
**Apply now and become our next Marketing Lead Pharmacy Business.
  
  
Please send your application by e-mail to Vicky van den Nieuwenhuyzen and Christine Maroy**
Whatever your area of expertise, your work within the Servier Group helps advance therapeutic progress for the benefit of patients. You will be part of teams recognized for their scientific excellence and reach your full potential in a professional environment that encourages you to develop yourself. Tailor-made onboarding journeys, mobility opportunities, quality trainings, responsible management, team spirit... All this and more in a workplace focused on your well-being.
  
  
At Servier, we are committed to therapeutic progress to serve patient needs. We put the diversity of our employees as a source of richness for the fulfillment of this vocation.

job.title: Brand Manager @ Novellas Healthcare (Brussels Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**Ready for your next step in pharmaceutical marketing?**

At Novellas Healthcare, we know the Life Sciences market from the inside. We work every day with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies as they develop their organisations, portfolios and future product launches. Drawing on this market knowledge, we bring professionals and organisations together based on expertise, ambition and a sustainable long-term match.

We are recruiting a
**Brand Manager Benelux**
for a European biopharmaceutical company. The organisation is entering an important phase of growth and is further expanding its commercial activities and portfolio across the Benelux.

For a marketing professional who enjoys taking responsibility and staying close to execution, this is an excellent opportunity to develop a brand, create local marketing initiatives and contribute to future product launches in an international, science-driven environment.

As
**Brand Manager Benelux**
, you will be responsible for the operational development and execution of marketing activities for your brand and therapeutic area (CNS – Cardiology).

You will translate the international marketing strategy into concrete local initiatives tailored to the Belgian and Dutch markets. You will work closely with Sales, Medical Affairs and other internal stakeholders, as well as external communications, digital and creative agencies.

You enjoy being directly involved in delivery. From developing campaigns and digital initiatives to following up on materials, congresses, budgets and results, you ensure that plans are turned into effective execution.

You will report to the Marketing Director Benelux while also working closely with European and international marketing teams.

**Key responsibilities**

* Develop and implement the local marketing and action plan for your brand, aligned with the international strategy and commercial objectives.
* Translate strategic plans into concrete marketing campaigns and activities for the Benelux.
* Play an active role in preparing and executing product and brand launches.
* Ensure the operational implementation and follow-up of marketing campaigns and product communications, in line with applicable pharmaceutical regulations and compliance requirements.
* Develop relevant digital and multichannel initiatives for healthcare professionals and, where applicable, patients, in collaboration with internal and external partners.
* Work regularly with external agencies, providing clear briefs and ensuring effective planning, follow-up and high-quality delivery.
* Coordinate with international marketing teams and adapt global strategies to the specific needs and characteristics of the Benelux markets.
* Monitor market trends, competitors and commercial performance, using available data and field feedback to identify opportunities and growth drivers.
* Define and monitor relevant marketing KPIs and adjust initiatives where needed.
* Support and organise national and international congresses, events and other relevant marketing activities.
* Work closely with Sales, Medical Affairs and other cross-functional teams.
* Manage the marketing budget for your activities and monitor schedules, costs, quality and deadlines.
* Contribute to strong brand positioning and continued brand development across the Benelux.

**Your professional profile**

* You hold a master’s degree or have an equivalent level of education, preferably in science, marketing or a related field.
* You have several years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with a clear focus on marketing and brand management.
* You have experience developing and operationally executing marketing campaigns and plans.
* Experience with a pharmaceutical product or brand launch is a significant asset.
* Experience in CNS, psychiatry or neurology is strongly preferred.
* You are familiar with digital marketing and multichannel communications and understand how to integrate different channels effectively.
* You have a good understanding of the regulations governing pharmaceutical promotion, communications and compliance.
* Experience with CRM systems such as Veeva is an advantage.
* You work effectively with external marketing, communications and creative agencies and can manage projects from briefing through implementation.
* You are hands-on and operationally minded. You contribute to strategic discussions but are equally motivated by turning plans into reality.
* You work independently and in an organised way, maintaining an overview of multiple projects, stakeholders, budgets and deadlines.
* You are results-driven, pragmatic and comfortable in a rapidly evolving organisation.
* You enjoy cross-functional collaboration and can bring internal and external stakeholders together around a shared goal.
* You have strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* You have a good command of Dutch, French and English.

**What do we offer**

* A varied marketing role within an international, science-driven biopharmaceutical organisation.
* The opportunity to contribute directly to brand development and future product launches across the Benelux.
* A role combining marketing strategy with substantial hands-on and operational responsibility.
* Close collaboration with experienced colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs and international teams.
* The opportunity to deliver innovative marketing initiatives with a range of external partners and agencies.
* An environment that values initiative, autonomy, pragmatism and collaboration.
* The opportunity to further develop your marketing expertise within an evolving organisation and product portfolio.
* Personal guidance from Novellas Healthcare throughout the selection process.

**Ready for your next step?**

Do you have experience in pharmaceutical marketing and enjoy turning strategy into concrete campaigns, launches and initiatives? Do you like working hands-on, close to the market and alongside different internal teams and external partners?

We would be pleased to hear from you.

**Colruyt Group, da’s een retailgroep met verschillende merken die duurzaam wil ondernemen om bewust consumeren mogelijk te maken. Als Brand Marketeer ontwikkel je een visie op de marktevolutie. Je versterkt onze marktpositie door strategische inzichten en advies te geven op basis van klanteninzichten en markttrends.**

**Jouw taken als Brand Marketeer:**

* Je ontwikkelt na analyse een visie op markttrends en -evoluties, en integreert klanteninzichten en marktdata om strategische beslissingen te onderbouwen.
* Je creëert en faciliteert een overkoepelende merkstrategie, en ontwerpt de brand architectuur inclusief hoofdmerken, submerken en services/producten.
* Je werkt mee aan het design om merken vorm te geven en bijhorende klantervaring te creëren.
* Je faciliteert workshops en strategische sessies om inzichten te verzamelen en strategische keuzes te maken.
* Je voert scenario-oefeningen uit om verschillende toekomstscenario’s te verkennen en de impact op het merk te evalueren.
* Je werkt nauw samen met directieteams en andere stakeholders om strategische doelen te bereiken. Samen implementeren en optimaliseren jullie de merkstrategie die je regelmatig evalueert.

**Profiel**

* **Kennis en ervaring:** Je hebt minimum 5 jaar ervaring in het vertalen van een merkvisie naar strategisch advies en het faciliteren van een besluitvorming. Je weet hoe je marktopportuniteiten identificeert en hebt ervaring in het organiseren van strategische sessies.
* **Analytisch vermogen:** Je hebt sterke analytische vaardigheden en kunt markttrends interpreteren.
* **Creatief en strategisch denkvermogen:** Jij bepaalt mee de merkidentiteit en -positionering van Colruyt Group en haar submerken. Je denkt creatief na, maar zonder de strategie uit het oog te verliezen.
* **Netwerker:** Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden. Hierdoor kan je effectief samenwerken met directieteams en andere stakeholders.
* **Talenkennis:** Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en het Frans.

Je kan vlot naar Halle komen voor minimum 3 dagen per week. Bij ons kan je tot 2 dagen per week van thuis werken of in een van onze regionale hubs (Zwijnaarde, Mechelen, Bornem of Haasrode).

**Wij bieden**

* **Variatie en impact:** Je krijgt de kans om dicht bij de business en in de actie te staan en zo mee te werken aan de merkstrategie voor verschillende merken van Colruyt Group.
* **Uitgebreid netwerk:** Je komt met verschillende stakeholders in contact uit verschillende departementen. Hierdoor bouw je snel een uitgebreid netwerk uit waar je in jouw verdere carrière op kan terugvallen. Daarnaast zijn Colruyt Groupies altijd bereid om te sparren en elkaar te ondersteunen.

* **Work life balans:** Bij ons kom je terecht in een mensgerichte omgeving waar ook privé telt. Wanneer het echter nodig is, kan je je agenda in functie van de workload aanpassen.
* **Aantrekkelijke verloning:** Naast een aantrekkelijk loon krijg je extralegale voordelen zoals winstdeelname, maaltijdcheques, een netto-vergoeding, een groeps-en hospitalisatieverzekering en een bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget.

Colruyt Group gelooft in de kracht van diversiteit, gelijkwaardigheid en inclusie. Iedereen is welkom om te solliciteren bij Colruyt Group en we bieden iedereen gelijke kansen.

job.title: Digital Marketeer @ Schuberg Philis (Schiphol, NH, NL)
job.description:
Schuberg Philis groeit. Vanuit Schiphol-Rijk en Rotterdam zijn we uitgebreid naar Eindhoven, Stockholm en Frankfurt. Daarmee breekt een volgende fase van nationale en internationale groei aan.

Marketing speelt daarin een centrale rol. Niet door zoveel mogelijk bereik of losse leads te produceren, maar door de juiste organisaties, beslissers en experts bij elkaar te brengen. We werken vanuit zes marketingthema’s, 170 gekwalificeerde klanten & prospects en een Account-Based Marketing-aanpak. De volgende stap is om onze doelgroepen nog persoonlijker en gerichter te bereiken en onze digitale marketing sneller, slimmer en schaalbaarder te maken.

Daarom zoeken we een **Digital Marketeer** die digital nativeness en tech savviness in ons team brengt. Iemand die zich gemakkelijk beweegt tussen digitale kanalen, data en tools en nieuwsgierig onderzoekt wat technologie voor onze marketing mogelijk maakt.

**Samen bouwen** **en draaien we onze marketingmachine**

Marketing is bij ons nadrukkelijk teamwork. Strategie, inhoud, creativiteit, design, technologie en uitvoering komen vanuit verschillende expertises samen. Jij verbindt die onderdelen in de dagelijkse praktijk en helpt het team om ideeën zorgvuldig en betrouwbaar naar de markt te brengen. Je werk bestaat uit drie samenhangende gebieden.

**Building** **the** **marketing machine**

Samen bouwen we aan de systemen, processen en digitale kanalen achter onze marketing. Denk aan onze website, het CRM, marketingautomation, e-mail, social media, advertising, analytics en eventmarketing.

Je bouwt landingspagina’s, formulieren, direct mailings, workflows, templates en dashboards. Ook help je de verschillende kanalen en systemen goed op elkaar aan te sluiten. Met collega’s onderzoek je hoe we terugkerend werk eenvoudiger kunnen organiseren of automatiseren, zodat het hele team efficiënt en consistent kan werken. Samen met collega’s interpreteer je de resultaten en bepaalt welke optimalisaties we kunnen behalen.

Je hoeft geen software-engineer te zijn, maar technische affiniteit en basiskennis zijn belangrijk. Je begrijpt op hoofdlijnen hoe websites, data, tracking, automatiseringen en koppelingen functioneren. Daardoor kun je zelf onderzoeken wat mogelijk is en ben je een inhoudelijke gesprekspartner voor technische collega’s, bureaus en leveranciers.

Je stelt kritische vragen en gaat niet alleen af op wat anderen zeggen dat wel of niet kan.

**Running** **the** **marketing machine**

Je helpt campagnes en marketingactiviteiten van voorbereiding naar livegang te brengen. Je werkt daarbij met de website, direct mailings vanuit het CRM, LinkedIn, andere socialmediakanalen en betaalde media. Ook ondersteun je de digitale communicatie rondom events.

Samen met collega’s vertaal je marketingplannen en content naar campagnes en digitale journeys. Je houdt de website actueel met nieuwe content, campagnes, inzichten en proposities en werkt met bestaande CRM-segmenten om communicatie gericht en relevant in te zetten.

Je zorgt dat pagina’s, formulieren, doelgroepen, mailings, advertenties en tracking goed worden ingericht en getest. Je controleert instellingen, links en dataverwerking en bewaakt de inhoudelijke, visuele en technische kwaliteit. Na de livegang monitor je de voortgang en zorg je dat kanalen, content en marketingtools actueel blijven. Je gebruikt A/B testen om te leren swelke boodschappen bij welke doelgroepen meer renderen.

In het begin werk je hierbij intensief samen met ervaren collega’s. Naarmate je groeit, pak je steeds zelfstandiger campagnes, kanalen en projecten op. Binnen het team neem je zo steeds meer eigenaarschap over de dagelijkse digitale marketingoperatie.

Je zorgt dat campagnes, kanalen, systemen en data goed samenwerken en dat collega’s erop kunnen vertrouwen dat onze marketingmachine snel, stabiel en voorspelbaar draait.

**Improving****the** **marketing machine**

Je gebruikt data en inzichten om onze digitale marketing gericht te verbeteren. Je analyseert website- en campagneprestaties en signaleert kansen op het gebied van vindbaarheid, gebruikerservaring, engagement en conversie.

Samen met het team vertaal je deze inzichten naar concrete verbeteringen in campagnes, pagina’s, mailings en digitale journeys. Je maakt experimenten technisch en operationeel eenvoudig uitvoerbaar en goed meetbaar. Wanneer een aanpak werkt, vertaal je die samen met het team naar herbruikbare templates, workflows en andere building blocks.

Zo verbeteren we niet alleen afzonderlijke campagnes, maar maken we onze volledige digitale marketing stap voor stap betrouwbaarder en schaalbaarder.

**Met wie werk je samen?**

job.title: Digital Brand Designer @ FeedbackFruits (Amsterdam, NH, NL)
job.description:
Hi, I'm Rosa, Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits.

As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role of design in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website and digital experiences, and on building the brand systems and workflows that help us do better work, more consistently.

That's why I'm looking for someone who can bring together strong visual design, digital thinking and a sense of ownership. Someone who can help shape where our brand goes next, improve how people experience us online, and build the foundations that enable the whole team to work smarter.

The first project you'd pick up with me is the one I'm most looking forward to. We're ready to evolve the brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product, and I've deliberately waited for this role before starting it. After that it's our website and digital brand experience, which you'd help shape with me rather than inherit finished, plus the campaigns and launches that put it all in front of people.

What I need alongside the craft is someone who takes real ownership of their work. Someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, pays attention to the details, and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution or bring a bold idea to the table. I want someone who looks beyond the task at hand, spots when something isn't working, and takes the initiative to make it better. We use AI a lot here, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to how we work. Look for ways to automate repetitive tasks, build useful templates and systems, and make it easier for the rest of the team to create good work without starting from scratch every time. The goal isn't just to get things done faster, but to make the work and the way we do it better.

There's room to shape this role and the brand itself. You'd help define where our digital brand goes next, influence how we work as a team, and have a real say in what we build. As the team grows, there's an opportunity for you to grow with it.

**What you'll do:**

* Design and evolve our website, landing pages and campaign experiences, from the thinking behind a page through to responsive designs and prototypes in Figma
* Help evolve our brand and visual language so it works across web, product and marketing
* Improve UX and UI across key website journeys, design with conversion in mind, and support experimentation
* Develop visual concepts and hero assets for campaigns and product launches, and carry them through to ads, social, ebooks, reports, presentations and event materials
* Build reusable templates, components and workflows so the team can move faster without losing consistency
* Bring structure to how design work gets requested, briefed, reviewed, handed off and approved
* Find the repetitive work that AI or automation can take over, and build assets colleagues can use themselves
* Brief and work with external specialists when a project needs development, motion, video or illustration

**What you bring:**

* You bring ownership to your projects. You take a brief, ask what it's for, and carry it to the finish without needing to be chased
* Your portfolio shows website, landing page and campaign design for tech/B2B brands, in house or agency. That matters more to me than the number of years behind it, though around 4+ years across digital, brand, web and marketing is roughly where this role is levelled at
* You're advanced in Figma, strong on UX/UI fundamentals and responsive design, and comfortable handing work to developers
* You think in systems. You notice when something is being made for the third time and turn it into a template
* You bring structure to loose or ambiguous briefs, and you're comfortable improving something that already exists rather than starting from a blank page
* You have high standards for craft and consistency, and you also know when something is good enough to ship
* You either illustrate, or your portfolio shows strong product visualization and composition

**What you get:**

* 25 paid holidays per year
* Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite)
* A day off for your birthday
* Advantageous pension scheme
* 3 days of volunteering leave per year
* €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning
* Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription
* Free access to our office gym
* Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation Range: €65K - €70K
